GitHub reports the pull request CONFLICTING with main's e82b013b6 (#2324). There are 8 conflicting files: contracts dispatch-api.ts and its test, web RefPreview.tsx, reference-target.ts and routes.ts, envoy AGENTS.md, api/comment_actions.go and docs/reference_excerpts.go. GitHub runs no checks on a conflicting head. Besides the text conflicts, the merge has to combine three behaviours. (1) Main removed refs.ReplaceCountedRefs, and editComment now calls replaceEditedReferences → ReplaceCountedEdit(previous, body). The edit must keep both this PR's block index with its carried ids and moved targets, and main's naming of the cited targets. (2) Main's blockQuery uses staleTime Infinity and is refreshed only by an event that names the block. This PR's comment and message routes carry `block`, and item-block targets are stored as comment_block/message_block, which main's CountedChanges drops. Without a refresh rule, a link or card to a comment block keeps its pre-edit text after a comment.edited. (3) Main's BlockPreview, useBlockDocument and prefetchReference read a document or issue summary for a block route. The item-block early return has to survive, so an item block names its comment or message and author, not a document.
